# The Steel Ship That Floats

## A Stone Sinks

Drop a stone in a pond. It sinks straight to the bottom, every time.

## A Ship Doesn't

A cargo ship, built almost entirely of steel — far *denser* than water (steel packs much more mass into the same amount of space) — floats.

**Both the stone and the ship are pulled down by the same Earth. So why does only one of them sink?**
